notes: Watched: ~1,874.5 episodes + 12 movies + 7.5h extras = ~778.7 hours (~32.4 days nonstop).
Recount Nov 16 (line-by-line, duplicates excluded): CW 163 + Perfect10 319 + Top9.5 705 + Loved9 375 + Liked8 215 + Mid 49 + Dropped 48.5 = 1,874.5 eps × 0.4h = 749.8h.
Section hours: CW 65.2, Perfect10 127.6, Top9.5 282.0, Loved9 150.0, Liked8 86.0, Mid 19.6, Dropped 19.4 = 749.8h.

Films: 12 = 21.4h (Dreaming Girl 1.5, Sister Venturing Out 1.25, Knapsack Kid 1.25, A Silent Voice 2.2, NGNL Zero 1.7, Suzume 2.0, Your Name 1.8, Weathering With You 1.9, Mugen Train 2.0, Chainsaw Man Reze 1.7, Saekano Finale 1.8, Quintuplets 2.27).
Extras: Eminence 6h (0 eps), Overflow ~1h (0 eps), I Want to Eat Your Pancreas ~0.5h → 7.5h.

Counted once: Rascal S1 (= Bunny Girl Senpai) and Santa Claus are in CW and only listed in Peak; Blue Box S1 is in CW and only listed in Perfect 10; the 3 Rascal films are in Films and only listed in Peak / Perfect 10. Spider 24 eps counted once (rewatch ~19.2h not added).
Peak Tier adds 0 unique eps: Bunny Girl S1 is the same 13 as Rascal S1 in CW.
Longest single series: Slime (96 eps), Dr. Stone (95), Demon Slayer (63), Shield Hero (62), SAO (~55), COTE (54), SLF (50), Apothecary (48).
Partial / estimated: Dr. Stone (~80/95), SAO S3 (~6 eps), AoT S2 (5–7), Kaguya (6), SPY S2 (~6).

yes: Game system, level-ups, boss fights, competent MC, nation building, science cheat, fast payoff.
Romance / life-reset / character drama with a strong hook (ReLIFE 10, Suzume 9.5).
Emotional gut-punch drama — A Silent Voice 10, Your Lie in April 9.5.
Quiet romance / step-sibling drama — Days with My Stepsister 10, Domestic Girlfriend 9, My Stepmom's Daughter 9.
no: Suffer-loop, depressed MC, slow slice-of-life, gag parody, politics-only without fights.
Tearjerker for its own sake (Pancreas dropped), slow-burn romance without drama (Horimiya ep 6 dropped).
taste.note: Observed tendencies, not rules — override anytime.
